//: The getting-started course, as `public/lessons.js` in prospektor-ai/studio holds it, read out of that checkout by `npm run lessons:snapshot`. Do not hand-edit: `/learn/` draws these pages from it (#742) and `tools/resources-coverage.js` checks their names against the product.

groups.name: Your first meeting from a cold company
Get walked in by someone you know
Make every pitch sharper than the last

lessons.subject: Your first leads are waiting
lessons.opener: Prospektor has picked companies that look like good customers for you. Each has a score out of 100 and one line on why.
bullets: Open Leads for you.
Press Glance on a company. In about 15 seconds you see who they are and why they fit.
Not a fit? Press Skip, and you’ll see fewer like it.
lessons.close: Start with the one you’d most like a meeting with.
lessons.label: Open Leads for you

lessons.subject: Get the first email written for you
lessons.opener: Yesterday you looked at a company. Today Prospektor writes what to send them.
bullets: Open that company and press Prospekt.
A few minutes later you have the first email, who to send it to, and why it matters to them.
lessons.close: You can close the tab. The pitch is saved in your Library when it’s done.
lessons.label: Open Leads for you

lessons.subject: Fix one line and every email gets better
lessons.opener: Open the email Prospektor wrote for you and change the sentence that doesn’t sound like you. Prospektor remembers it and writes the next email closer to how you talk.
bullets: Open the Library and pick the pitch.
Press Edit on the email, change what you’d never say, and press Save.
lessons.close: Then send it from your own inbox.
lessons.label: Open the Library

lessons.subject: Who do you already know?
lessons.opener: Upload your LinkedIn connections once. From then on, every pitch tells you if someone you know works there, or knows someone who does.
bullets: In LinkedIn, export your connections. You get a file called Connections.csv.
Drop it on Your network. A pasted list of names and companies works too.
We don’t keep their email addresses, and only you can delete the list.
lessons.label: Open Your network

lessons.subject: Get introduced instead of emailing cold
lessons.opener: Type a company you want to reach. Prospektor shows who you know who can introduce you to the person who decides, and drafts the ask for you.
bullets: Type the company on Warm intros.
Pick the best path and send the request it wrote.
lessons.close: Every finished pitch shows the same thing under Warm paths.
lessons.label: Open Warm intros

lessons.subject: Find your competitors’ customers
lessons.opener: A company that buys from your competitor already pays for what you sell. Prospektor finds them on public pages, like a competitor’s case studies and customer logos.
bullets: Open Counterprospekt and press Find their clients on a competitor, or add one by name.
Every customer it finds links to the page that names them.
lessons.close: Tomorrow you pitch one of them.
lessons.label: Open Counterprospekt

lessons.subject: Pitch one of your competitor’s customers
lessons.opener: Pick the best fit from yesterday’s list and get the email written.
bullets: Press Glance on the customer you’d most like to win.
Press Write the pitch.
When it’s ready, open it and send the email.
lessons.close: Tomorrow: what to do when they answer.
lessons.label: Open Counterprospekt

lessons.subject: Tell Prospektor what happened
lessons.opener: Did they reply, book a meeting, or say no? Mark it on the lead. Prospektor uses what worked and what didn’t to write your next pitches.
bullets: Press the badge on a lead and pick what happened.
Add one line on why, in your own words. That line helps the most.
lessons.close: Press Make sense of this to see what’s winning and what isn’t.
lessons.label: Open Outcomes

lessons.subject: Teach it from your sales calls
lessons.opener: If Fathom, Otter, Granola or Zoom records your calls, upload the transcripts. Prospektor picks out the objections and questions buyers raise.
bullets: Export up to six transcripts.
Press Bring your call recordings on Outcomes.
Press Keep on what’s worth remembering.
lessons.close: Your next pitches answer them up front.
lessons.label: Open Outcomes
